title: brain-eval pilot item
description: One row of data/pilot_ru_ky.jsonl. Questions are regenerated from production topics, never copied; no personal data.

id.description: stable id, e.g. ru-012 / ky-012; ru-NNN and ky-NNN with the same NNN are a parallel pair

topic.description: admission | cost | documents | hostel | schedule | university | other | ood

ood.description: true for deliberately out-of-domain questions the corpus cannot answer

evidence.description: retrieved passages shown to the generator, in rank order

answer.description: the assistant's answer produced from exactly this evidence
